items.title: Ray Bryant interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: he had his own band there. I didn’t play with him much but he was, the bands would alternate you know.

ctx.x: Yeah but he was very — he had his own band there. I didn’t play with him much but he was, the bands would alternate you know. And there was — avante gardists were going pretty good at that time. I mean at night time I played downtown at the Five Spot with

guys like Benny Golson, Curtis Fuller, like that. So I was very busy when I first came to New York, because I already knew most of the people, so it seems like when they found out that I was here I got busier than I could really handle.
